import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected="6e39cbcd7f1c3ca8f0ebfac6a2b9d6b2948a1b58"

def run(args, check=True, env=None):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True,check=check,env=env)

head=run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()
status=run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout.strip()
if head != expected or status:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected isolated state head={head} status={status!r}")

env=os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"]=str(wt/"src")
suite=run(["python3","-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests"],check=False,env=env)
print("=== full stdout ===")
print(suite.stdout)
print("=== full stderr ===")
print(suite.stderr)
print("full_rc="+str(suite.returncode))
if suite.returncode != 0:
    raise SystemExit(suite.returncode)
print("head_after="+run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip())
print("status_after="+repr(run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout))
